## Goal
- Complete safe production readiness validation for the IVX owner-gated autonomous worker without exposing credentials or bypassing approval controls.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Preserve Supabase registered-owner JWT authorization and HMAC, expiring, single-use, exact action/SHA-bound approvals.
- Never expose, print, commit, transfer, infer, or accept secret values in ordinary chat.
- Do not impersonate the worker, forge approvals, weaken authorization, bypass approvals, or manufacture production evidence.
- Do not perform GitHub source mutation, Render deployment, or consume approvals without a fresh, owner-gated, exact-current-SHA workflow.
- Keep public policy blocks as HTTP `200` renderable turns; keep authorization failures as `401`/`403`.
- Exclude unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` changes from backend release commits.
- Do not publish mobile binaries or submit to Google Play, App Store, or TestFlight.

## Progress
### Done
- Published reviewed autonomous-worker hardening to GitHub `main`:
  - Commit: `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`
  - Message: `fix: harden autonomous worker approvals and deployment flow`
  - URL: `https://github.com/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/commit/9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`
- Verified API and worker deployment SHA parity:
  - API service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`, live deployment `dep-d9i27jernols738pugkg`.
  - Worker service `srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0`, live deployment `dep-d9i27jmrnols738puh1g`.
  - Both identify `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`.
- Verified public API health:
  - `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returns healthy HTTP `200`.
  - Latest non-secret runtime health now reports:
    - `variablesValidated:true`
    - `toolRegistryReady:true`
    - `github.canReadRepo:true`
    - `github.canPush:true`
    - `render.canDeploy:true`
- Confirmed API AI provider readiness independently:
  - `aiStartupValidation.ok:true`
  - Provider: `vercel_ai_gateway`
  - Model: `openai/gpt-4o`
  - Key status was reported only as loaded/redacted; no value was emitted.
- Safely configured `IVX_INTERNAL_API_URL=https://api.ivxholding.com` on the worker through the Render read-merge-write approach without revealing secrets.
- Confirmed unsigned internal deployment authorization remains protected:
  - `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/internal-deployment-authorizations/consume`
  - Returns HTTP `401` without signed worker headers.
  - Error: `Required signed worker authentication headers are missing.`
  - `secretValuesReturned:false`.
- Focused control validation passed:
  - `bun test backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts backend/tests/ivx-render-env-merge.test.ts`
  - `15 pass`, `0 fail`, `46 expect() calls`.
- Root dependency installation completed:
  - `bun install --frozen-lockfile`
- iOS validation completed:
  - `functions.runChecks` build for `ios-ivx-holdings` passed.
  - Swift scan found no `TODO`, `FIXME`, `fatalError(`, or force-unwrap matches.
- Confirmed worker implementation requirements and sequence in `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`:
  - Requires `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_REPO_URL`, `RENDER_API_KEY`, `RENDER_SERVICE_ID`, and `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`.
  - Pipeline: `PLANNING → INSPECTING → IMPLEMENTING → TESTING → WAITING_APPROVAL → COMMITTING → DEPLOYING → LIVE_VERIFYING → VERIFIED`.
- Confirmed owner-only worker APIs exist and remain guarded:
  - `backend/api/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`
  - `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`
- `git diff --check` passed; only unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` artifacts were shown as modified.

### In Progress
- Reconcile the API runtime readiness report with the dedicated Render worker’s independent secret-presence inventory.
- Perform a non-mutating owner-gated worker readiness check only after the worker itself reports a usable planner credential.
- Capture complete final totals for the broader installed-root autonomous-worker regression command.
- Restore Expo workspace dependencies and run real Expo lint/native validation.

### Blocked
- Direct safe Render inventory for worker `ivx-senior-dev-01` still reports:
  - `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY:false`
  - `OPENAI_API_KEY:false`
- The worker has not received a newer deployment after the user’s Render dashboard edits:
  - Still live: `dep-d9i27jmrnols738puh1g`
  - Commit: `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`
- No worker-specific Render deploy/restart is visible in the latest deploy list.
- Full autonomous planning, code-write, and deployment verification cannot begin until the dedicated worker—not merely the API runtime—has a non-empty `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
- Safe API environment merge remains PARTIAL because post-write validation previously identified missing/unreadable:
  - `OPENAI_API_KEY`
  - `IVX_OWNER_REGISTRATION_EMAILS`
  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`
- Expo workspace remains missing local lint dependencies:
  - `bun run lint` → `bunx expo lint`
  - Error: `Error: Cannot find module 'eslint'`.
  - `functions.install` cannot target `expo`: `No app is registered at path "expo".`
- No post-commit `RENDER_DEPLOY` authorization can exist until a real worker-produced commit SHA exists.
- Freeze-risk audit remains PARTIAL:
  - Prior scan: `189` freeze risks and `203` high-severity findings remain unclassified.

## Key Decisions
- Treat the dedicated Render worker inventory as the authority for worker planner-key readiness; API runtime readiness does not prove the separate worker has the credential.
- Do not copy the API’s AI credential to the worker, inspect values, or request values in chat.
- Use `backend/services/ivx-render-env-merge.ts` for any Render update because Render variable `PUT` replaces the full set.
- Treat any missing-variable result from safe merge validation as failure/PARTIAL, even when intended variables were added.
- Preserve approval order:
  - `GITHUB_WRITE` approval binds to the current pre-write GitHub HEAD.
  - `RENDER_DEPLOY` approval binds to the actual resulting worker-produced commit SHA.
- Do not restart, deploy, create a task, create/consume approval, mutate GitHub, or claim `VERIFIED` merely to demonstrate progress.
- Treat deployment parity and health as release-readiness evidence, not evidence of a completed autonomous run.

## Next Steps
1. Recheck Render `srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0` after its next configuration propagation/redeploy for presence-only `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
2. If neither credential is present, ensure the variable is added directly to Render service `ivx-senior-dev-01`, not only the API service or project-level environment.
3. Once present, verify worker planning readiness, GitHub read/push capability, and Render deployment capability through non-secret worker/API status evidence.
4. Re-run and capture full totals for:
   - `bun test backend/ivx-senior-dev-self-deploy-recovery.test.ts backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-autonomous-mode.test.ts backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.test.ts backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts backend/tests/ivx-render-env-merge.test.ts`
5. Generate a fresh registered-owner session and short-lived `GITHUB_WRITE` authorization bound to current GitHub HEAD.
6. Submit only the reviewed minimal non-functional drill against `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-client.ts`.
7. Verify worker planning, inspection, implementation, tests, and worker-generated commit evidence through owner-gated jobs and proof ledger.
8. Create a separate resulting-SHA-bound `RENDER_DEPLOY` authorization; then verify Render deployment, GitHub/API/worker SHA parity, health, and durable `VERIFIED` evidence.
9. Restore Expo dependencies and run `bunx expo lint` plus Expo Go/native validation without publishing binaries.
10. Update `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md` with PASS/PARTIAL/BLOCKED evidence.

## Critical Context
- Current authorized GitHub `main`, API deployment, worker deployment, and API health commit identify:
  - `9566249e9d97bb5e6e8ee689bc95457e16ab9011`
- API service:
  - `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
  - Live deployment: `dep-d9i27jernols738pugkg`

  - `srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0`

  - Present: `IVX_INTERNAL_API_URL`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_REPO_URL`, `RENDER_API_KEY`, `RENDER_SERVICE_ID`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET`, `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID`.
  - Absent: `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
  - No secret values were returned.
- Latest API health runtime differs from prior checks and now reports:
  - `variablesValidated:true`
  - `toolRegistryReady:true`
  - `githubRead:true`
  - `githubPush:true`
  - `renderDeploy:true`
- Prior API health state reported all of the above as false. This change must not be treated as worker planner-key proof.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-ai.ts` resolves only:
  - `readEnv('OPENAI_API_KEY') || readEnv('AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY')`
  - Gateway URL: `https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/chat/completions`
  - Default model: `openai/gpt-4o`.
- Previous safe negative drill remains valid:
  - `GITHUB_WRITE` approval: `3857302f-d0d8-4429-aa88-ffbf21612ffd`
  - Task: `87a89317-add6-4e6d-a542-87176dd17877`

  - Failure: `PLANNING failed: AI gateway key not configured (OPENAI_API_KEY or AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY).`
  - No files changed, commit created, deployment triggered, or approval consumed.
- No runtime logs are available through `rork-agent`; applicable evidence is owner-gated jobs/ledger, Render state, environment key-presence checks, and health/status endpoints.
